title: 台北一日遊 — One Day in Taipei
summary: A weekend trip to attractions in Taipei.

paragraphs.hanzi: 上個星期六，我和朋友去台北玩。
paragraphs.pinyin: shàng ge xīngqīliù, wǒ hé péngyou qù táiběi wán.
paragraphs.translation: Last Saturday, my friend and I went to Taipei to have fun.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕㄤˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄥ ㄑㄧ ㄌㄧㄡˋ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄏㄜˊ ㄆㄥˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄑㄩˋ ㄊㄞˊ ㄅㄟˇ ㄨㄢˊ。
paragraphs.text: 上個星期六，我和朋友去台北玩。
paragraphs.romanization: shàng ge xīngqīliù, wǒ hé péngyou qù táiběi wán.
paragraphs.translation_en: Last Saturday, my friend and I went to Taipei to have fun.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sabtu lalu, teman saya dan saya pergi ke Taipei untuk bersenang-senang.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我們先去了故宮博物院，看到了很多古老的東西。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǒmen xiān qù le gùgōng bówùyuàn, kàn dào le hěn duō gǔlǎo de dōngxi.
paragraphs.translation: We first went to the National Palace Museum and saw many ancient things.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄑㄩˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄍㄨˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄅㄛˊ ㄨˋ ㄩㄢˋ， ㄎㄢˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄍㄨˇ ㄌㄠˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄉㄨㄥ ㄒㄧ。
paragraphs.text: 我們先去了故宮博物院，看到了很多古老的東西。
paragraphs.romanization: wǒmen xiān qù le gùgōng bówùyuàn, kàn dào le hěn duō gǔlǎo de dōngxi.
paragraphs.translation_en: We first went to the National Palace Museum and saw many ancient things.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami pertama-tama pergi ke Museum Istana Nasional dan melihat banyak benda kuno.

paragraphs.hanzi: 中午我們去吃了一碗牛肉麵，很好吃。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhōngwǔ wǒmen qù chī le yì wǎn niúròu miàn, hěn hǎochī.
paragraphs.translation: At noon we went to eat a bowl of beef noodles; it was delicious.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄨㄥ ㄨˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄑㄩˋ ㄔ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄧ ㄨㄢˇ ㄋㄧㄡˊ ㄖㄡˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ， ㄏㄣˇ ㄏㄠˇ ㄔ。
paragraphs.text: 中午我們去吃了一碗牛肉麵，很好吃。
paragraphs.romanization: zhōngwǔ wǒmen qù chī le yì wǎn niúròu miàn, hěn hǎochī.
paragraphs.translation_en: At noon we went to eat a bowl of beef noodles; it was delicious.
paragraphs.translation_id: Siang hari kami makan semangkuk mi sapi; rasanya lezat.

paragraphs.hanzi: 下午我們去了象山，從山上看台北非常漂亮。
paragraphs.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒmen qù le xiàngshān, cóng shān shàng kàn táiběi fēicháng piàoliang.
paragraphs.translation: In the afternoon we went to Elephant Mountain; Taipei looked very beautiful from the top.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄨˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄑㄩˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄕㄢ， ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄕㄢ ㄕㄤˋ ㄎㄢˋ ㄊㄞˊ ㄅㄟˇ ㄈㄟ ㄔㄤˊ ㄆㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄧㄤˋ。
paragraphs.text: 下午我們去了象山，從山上看台北非常漂亮。
paragraphs.romanization: xiàwǔ wǒmen qù le xiàngshān, cóng shān shàng kàn táiběi fēicháng piàoliang.
paragraphs.translation_en: In the afternoon we went to Elephant Mountain; Taipei looked very beautiful from the top.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sore harinya kami pergi ke Gunung Gajah; Taipei terlihat sangat indah dari puncak.

title: 可能 — probably, maybe, perhaps
summary: A short passage about probably, maybe, perhaps.
summary_en: A short passage about probably, maybe, perhaps.

paragraphs.text: 你最好提前出門，不然可能趕不上火車。
paragraphs.hanzi: 你最好提前出門，不然可能趕不上火車。
paragraphs.pinyin: nǐ zuì hǎo tí qián chū mén ， bù rán kě néng gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄊㄧˊ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄔㄨ ㄇㄣˊ ， ㄅㄨˋ ㄖㄢˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄍㄢˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Nǐ zuìhǎo tíqián chūmén, bùrán kěnéng gǎn bu shàng huǒchē.
paragraphs.translation: You had better leave early, otherwise you may not catch the train.
paragraphs.translation_en: You had better leave early, otherwise you may not catch the train.

paragraphs.text: 文件太大，上傳過程可能需要幾分鐘。
paragraphs.hanzi: 文件太大，上傳過程可能需要幾分鐘。
paragraphs.pinyin: wén jiàn tài dà ， shàng chuán guò chéng kě néng xū yào jǐ fēn zhōng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄣˊ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄉㄚˋ ， ㄕㄤˋ ㄔㄨㄢˊ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄈㄣ ㄓㄨㄥ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Wénjiàn tài dà, shàngchuán guòchéng kěnéng xūyào jǐ fēnzhōng.
paragraphs.translation: The file is too large, so the upload process may take a few minutes.
paragraphs.translation_en: The file is too large, so the upload process may take a few minutes.
paragraphs.translation_id: Silakan pindai kontrak yang ditandatangani dan unggah ke sistem.

paragraphs.text: 我最近不太閒，可能要下週才能見面。
paragraphs.hanzi: 我最近不太閒，可能要下週才能見面。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǒ zuì jìn bù tài xián ， kě néng yào xià zhōu cái néng jiàn miàn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄒㄧㄢˊ ， ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄓㄡ ㄘㄞˊ ㄋㄥˊ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Wǒ zuìjìn bú tài xián, kěnéng yào xià zhōu cái néng jiànmiàn.
paragraphs.translation: I have not been very free recently, so I may not be able to meet until next week.
paragraphs.translation_en: I have not been very free recently, so I may not be able to meet until next week.
paragraphs.translation_id: Akhir-akhir ini aku tidak punya banyak waktu luang, jadi aku mungkin baru bisa bertemu minggu depan.

title: 孩子 — kids,child, childern / son, daughter
title_en: 孩子 — kids,child, childern / son, daughter
summary: A short passage about kids,child, childern / son, daughter.
summary_en: A short passage about kids,child, childern / son, daughter.

paragraphs.text: 天氣太熱了，孩子們都想吃雪糕。
paragraphs.hanzi: 天氣太熱了，孩子們都想吃雪糕。
paragraphs.pinyin: tiān qì tài rè le ， hái zi men dōu xiǎng chī xuě gāo 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄧㄢ ㄑㄧˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄖㄜˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ， ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄉㄡ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄔ ㄒㄩㄝˇ ㄍㄠ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tiānqì tài rè le, háizimen dōu xiǎng chī xuěgāo.
paragraphs.translation: The weather is so hot that the children all want to eat ice cream.
paragraphs.translation_en: The weather is so hot that the children all want to eat ice cream.
paragraphs.translation_id: Cuacanya panas sekali sehingga anak-anak semua ingin makan es krim.

paragraphs.text: 孩子還小，只能從一數到二十。
paragraphs.hanzi: 孩子還小，只能從一數到二十。
paragraphs.pinyin: hái zi hái xiǎo ， zhǐ néng cóng yī shù dào èr shí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄏㄞˊ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ， ㄓˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄧ ㄕㄨˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄦˋ ㄕˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Háizi hái xiǎo, zhǐ néng cóng yī shǔ dào èrshí.
paragraphs.translation: The child is still young and can only count from one to twenty.
paragraphs.translation_en: The child is still young and can only count from one to twenty.
paragraphs.translation_id: Anak tersebut masih kecil dan baru bisa berhitung dari satu sampai dua puluh.

paragraphs.text: 孩子的嘴巴上沾了巧克力。
paragraphs.hanzi: 孩子的嘴巴上沾了巧克力。
paragraphs.pinyin: hái zi de zuǐ bā shàng zhān le qiǎo kè lì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄗㄨㄟˇ ㄅㄚ ㄕㄤˋ ㄓㄢ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄑㄧㄠˇ ㄎㄜˋ ㄌㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Háizi de zuǐba shang zhān le qiǎokèlì.
paragraphs.translation: The child has chocolate stuck around their mouth.
paragraphs.translation_en: The child has chocolate stuck around their mouth.
paragraphs.translation_id: Anak itu ada cokelat yang menempel di sekitar mulutnya.

paragraphs.text: 孩子把氣球系在椅子上。
paragraphs.hanzi: 孩子把氣球系在椅子上。
paragraphs.pinyin: hái zi bǎ qì qiú xì zài yǐ zi shàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄅㄚˇ ㄑㄧˋ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄒㄧˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄧˇ ㄗ˙ ㄕㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Háizi bǎ qìqiú jì zài yǐzi shang.
paragraphs.translation: The child tied the balloon to the chair.
paragraphs.translation_en: The child tied the balloon to the chair.
paragraphs.translation_id: Anak itu mengikat balon itu ke kursi.

paragraphs.text: 書架太高了，孩子夠不到最上面那一層。
paragraphs.hanzi: 書架太高了，孩子夠不到最上面那一層。
paragraphs.pinyin: shū jià tài gāo le ， hái zi gòu bú dào zuì shàng miàn nà yī céng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕㄨ ㄐㄧㄚˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄍㄠ ㄌㄜ˙ ， ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄍㄡˋ ㄅㄨˊ ㄉㄠˋ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄋㄚˋ ㄧ ㄘㄥˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Shūjià tài gāo le, háizi gòu bu dào zuì shàngmiàn nà yì céng.
paragraphs.translation: The bookshelf is too high, so the child cannot reach the top shelf.
paragraphs.translation_en: The bookshelf is too high, so the child cannot reach the top shelf.
paragraphs.translation_id: Rak buku itu terlalu tinggi, sehingga anak itu tidak bisa menjangkau rak paling atas.
